description: The bar chart illustrates the number of participants (N=6) who identified each evaluation criterion as beneficial in the context of a generative-AI-driven claim retrieval system for social media content across multiple languages. The vertical axis lists seven criteria: “Relevant FCs,” “FC Summary,” “Relevance Explanation,” “Clarity and Simplicity,” “Overall Summary,” “Filters,” and “Veracity Explanation,” arranged from top to bottom in descending order of participant endorsement. The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Participants,” spans from 0 to 6 in increments of 2, representing the count of participants selecting each criterion. Each criterion is represented by a horizontal bar of distinct color: “Relevant FCs” (dark purple, 6 participants), “FC Summary” (dark blue, 5), “Relevance Explanation” (teal, 3), “Clarity and Simplicity” (green-teal, 3), “Overall Summary” (light green, 2), “Filters” (lime green, 1), and “Veracity Explanation” (yellow-green, 1). The chart visually emphasizes that “Relevant FCs” was universally selected, while “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” received the least support, each chosen by only one participant. No grouping or stacking is present; bars are sorted in descending order by participant count, and no annotations or emphasis beyond color coding are applied.
